title: Pelican Pedal
description: Help Pip the pelican pedal across a bright seaside trail, leap over broken bridges, and stomp the marsh monsters.
instructions: Press Left and Right alternately to pedal. Press Space to jump over gaps and onto monsters. Keep your rhythm to build speed, and use the on-screen pedals and jump button on touch devices.

achievements.title: Monster Masher
achievements.description: Stomp or jump safely past 10 monsters across all rides.
